147-653-5231.description:

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.

Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening

Repeat from step 3.

When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
2511-3249-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

4659-5086-5183-6753-6996.description:

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

222-2921-4871--73.easyPrerequisites:
The persist or undying creature doesn't have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, respective to its ability.
You control a Saproling.
222-2921-4871--73.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the persist or undying creature and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and the other creature's persist or undying ability triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying or persist creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and the persist or undying creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

423-1437-3819-3861.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Cultivator Colossus spell three times.
Resolve the first Cultivator Colossus copy.
The Cultivator Colossus token enters the battlefield, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield, drawing a card, and choosing not to repeat the process.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3819-3861.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

3817-4605-5147-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Play Dakmor Salvage.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.

When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

3234-3293-4050-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4050-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
3234-3293-4050-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Repeat, tapping the Eternal Witness and Great Whale tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When Ozox dies, it and Ogre Slumlord trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.

When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
